figurative_meaning_en: Stubborn fool, arrogant and willful person
similar_in_english: Like a bull in a china shop
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একটা আসল ষাঁড়, কারও কথা শোনে না।
আমার বসের মতো উদ্ধত ষাঁড় আর কোথাও দেখিনি।
example_sentences_in_english: He is a real bull, doesn't listen to anyone.
I've never seen an arrogant bull like my boss.
note: The idiom draws from the aggressive and stubborn nature of bulls in rural Bengali life.
